[p align="justify"]Kintarō & Kuma: Dual gameplay style! Kuma, the bear, can be controlled with the right joystick (point with the mouse & A on KB+M)
[p align="justify"]Mounted Stance:
[p align="justify"]Claw Swipes (ATTACK)

[p align="justify"]3 premium Outfits (Raven, Nightmare, Royal Counselor)
[p align="justify"]3 new achievements (Steam only)
Talents Reworks
SCARLET
Devourer: Is now a repeatable quest, granting +0.4/0.5/0.6/0.7 DMG when killing an enemy with the POWER ability in Wolf form
Short Wick: Talent removed and replaced with ‘Deadly Combo’
(New Behavior) Distant Explosion: Bombs now explode as soon as they hit the ground. SPECIAL’s explosion does not stun Scarlet anymore
(ULTIMATE Ability) Hunter’s Souvenir: Players can now consume multiple charges of the Shotgun ultimate in quick succession instead of automatically exiting the ability
Murderous Intent: Combo points granted increased from 2 to 3
Evisceration: Damage dealt in Bleed per combo point spent increased from 8/10/12/14% to 16/20/24/28%
Human form: HP restored increased from 3/4/5/6 to 5/6/7/8
Wolf form: SHIELD applied to Heroes increased from 12-25/13-27/15-30/16-32 to 15-28/18-35/22-42/26-49
Reload: Talent removed and replaced with ‘Focus’
Human form: The shotgun fires piercing bullets with greater range, dealing 350/437/525/612 damage
Wolf form: The gust summons a tornado that remains on the ground, dealing 70/87/105/122 damage per second
(New Talent) Deadly Combo: POWER ends with an area attack dealing 40/50/60/70% damage
Transformation: Scarlet can no longer shapeshift into a Werewolf and back while a Master Nightmare is stunned

Design Notes: As the oldest character developed, Scarlet had some issues we can finally address. She had multiple effects in Talents that cleared or reduced cooldowns. These effects are not very exciting, since they kind of overlap with Magical Objects doing the same thing.

So we reworked Devourer, Short Wick, and Reload for these reasons. Integrating the other aspect of Short Wick into Distant Explosion lets us really offer a different game feel for this Starting Talent, while Devourer opens a new path to scaling and POWER-centric builds, especially with the introduction of the Deadly Combo Talent. With these changes, we aimed to rekindle interest in all of her Starting Talents.
THE PIED PIPER
Rats: Rats do not automatically attack enemies that are not in combat after killing an enemy in combat
Sound Barrier: ARMOR granted from +1 to +1.5, SHIELD gain from 12/15/18/21 to 15/18/21/24
Explosive Blast: Damage dealt increased from 40/50/60/70 to 45/56/67/78

(New Behavior) Stimulant Vibes: Rats can now die within the SPECIAL zone, but have a 50/63/75/88% chance to respawn when they die. This allows effects like ‘Explosive Rats’ to proc and generate additional damage
Rats attacking within SPECIAL's zone gain +20% damage, and rats have a 50% chance to respawn when they die
Rat King: Rat Kings now also increase damage dealt by explosive Rats by 100% when they die

Design Notes: The main rework is about Stimulant Vibes, which prevented Rats from dying. By design, Rats are meant to die, encouraging synergy with Talents that allow better Rat generation. We changed it to ensure that all Rat-related Talents synergize well.
BEOWULF
Shield Charge: Damage increased from +100/125/150/175% to +150/187/225/262%
Sudden Growth: Damage increased from +20/25/30/35% to +40/50/60/70%. Zone size has also been increased
Battle Cry: Now increases Move Speed of all Heroes around instead of removing POWER Cooldown
Bladestorm: Adapted description to specify that Beowulf remains INTANGIBLE through all additional spins
Secondary Tremor: Talent removed and replaced by ‘Maelstrom’
(New Talent) Maelstrom: SPECIAL’s final hit deals +24/30/36/42% damage for each enemy already hit (up to +120/150/180/210%)

Design Notes: The Battle Cry change is about the same thing we did for Scarlet. Ability cooldown resets are rarely good in Talents. The new effect is more tangible for all Heroes around. Secondary Tremor suffered from a lack of control over where the shockwave would go in the end. We now propose Maelstrom to strengthen the SPECIAL-oriented builds.
SNOW QUEEN
(SPECIAL Ability) Ice Shards: Damage increased from 65 to 80
(DEFENSE Ability) Ice Skating: Increased minimum cooldown of the DEFENSE ability from 2 to 5
(New Behavior) Frost Queen: Removed the additional slowdown on enemies. Replaced with:
Enemies CHILLED by the Snow Queen suffer 5 damage per second
Ice Spray: Damage increased from 20/25/30/35% to 32/40/48/56%
Ice Beam: Damage increased from 160% to 180/225/270/315%
Ice Cores: Now summons 2 cores of ice for each enemy hit by POWER (from 1)

Design Notes: SPECIAL-oriented builds for the Snow Queen have always been considered to be too weak compared to others, so we improved its default damage and improved the related Talents to make them more efficient.
ALADDIN
(SPECIAL Ability) Enchanted Blades: Blades can now, by default, be recalled sooner by triggering SPECIAL again
Aerial Catch: Increased ARMOR gained from +1 to +2
Jinn’s Might: The maximum charge is now reached faster
Cyclonic Appearance: Talent removed and replaced with ‘Jinn Charge’
Dancing Blades: Talent removed and replaced with ‘Spectral Blades’
(New Talent) Jinn Charge: DASH used after POWER summons the Jinn to charge through enemies and deal 25/31/37/43 damage
(New Talent) Spectral Blades: Retrieving SPECIAL’s blades before they return to Aladdin triggers a flurry of attacks that can deal up to 44/55/66/77 area damage

Design Notes: Cyclonic Appearance had too small of an application/synergy with the behavior of the POWER itself. While Dancing Blades didn’t have a huge impact on SPECIAL-oriented builds, as it was mainly a source of additional ENERGY. This opened up two slots to create new Talents with better synergies with his kit.
MELUSINE
Shimmering Scales: Temporary ARMOR gained every second increased from +4/6/8/10 to +8/12/16/20. You can now reach the max value quicker
Underwater Predator: Melusine's speed has been increased when underwater
Enduring Wisp: The Wisp does not automatically attack enemies that are not in combat
GEPPETTO
Unstable Core: Time before effect is active reduced from 5 seconds to 3 seconds
Master Puppet: Max Health gain increased from +20/25/30/35% to +32/40/48/56% and damage increased from 10/12/14/16% to 16/20/24/28%
Nailing Strike: Attack speed has been increased
Reduced HP from 200 to 180
Mecha Puppet is now affected by ‘Unstable Core’, triggering an explosion on death only (not when hit by a POWER ability
SUN WUKONG
Way of Awakening: Reduced the number of DEFENSE actions necessary from 8 to 7
Thirst for Immortality: Changed the rarity of objects needed from RARE to EPIC or better
Stick Twirl: Doesn’t interrupt attack combo anymore
Ringing Beads: When used with ‘Ōm’, Beads scale in size as well to keep hitting enemies
Focused Strikes: Reduced damage from +12/16/20/24% to 8/10/12/14%

Design Notes: The idea behind Thirst of Immortality is to have a Starting Talent acting as a long quest, with little immediate reward and a major reward upon completion. Through game updates, it became easier to collect 7 rare+ Magical Objects very quickly, and the huge VITALITY buff let it snowball very fast. Making the Objects epic+ keeps the idea of the Talent while delaying its completion more (you don’t become “immortal” easily!). Also, we tempered Focused Strikes damage output because it benefits a lot from synergies with other POWER talents, plus it makes this ability able to deal all damage to a single target, although POWER is basically balanced to strike multiple targets. This should still remain really strong, though.
CARMILLA

(New Behavior) Seductive Provocation: Using DASH input without specifying a move direction makes Carmilla seduce up to 4 non-boss enemies in front of her, applying WEAKENED and VULNERABLE to them for 6/7/9/10 seconds
Seductive Provocation now inflicts Stun and Stagger
Used to scale on the maximum number of enemies affected, now scales on the duration of the effect
Dash is no longer consumed
Attack animation has been greatly accelerated
(ULTIMATE Ability) Impalement: Consume all BLOOD even in Winged Form (was not the case before)
(ULTIMATE Ability) Blood Lash: Blood collected increased from 2/2/6 to 6/6/12
Life Tap: Health consumed from 20% to 15%, BLOOD collected from 30/40/50/60 to 40/50/60/70, cooldown from 5 seconds to 10 seconds
‘Life Tap’ now triggers every TRAIT Talent
Bat Master: Reduced damage from +40/50/60/70% to +20/25/30/35%
Design Notes: A new take on Seductive Provocation! We also adjusted Life Tap that was on the weak side, and Bat Master so it remains mainly a “utility” starting Talent.
ROMEO
Love Thread: Increased damage from 33/41/50/58 to 44/55/65/76
(ULTIMATE Ability) Black Roses: Cooldown reduced from 75 to 60 seconds
(New Behavior) Panache: Each Panache token increases ATTACK damage by 20% instead of granting +5 DMG
Secret Weapon: Damage increased from +32/40/48/56% to +40/50/60/70%. Now up to 4 successful blocks instead of 3
Ice Rose: Damage reduced to +32/40/48/56% from 40/50/60/70%
Kick: Damage is now displayed in numerical value. Damage increased from 44 (400%) to 48 (436%).
Wind Spiral: VFX adjusted to better match the attack

Design Notes: An overall buff of underused Talents. New Panache opens up to a more specific synergy with ATTACKS. Ice Rose bonus damage has been toned down a little due to the amount of easy synergies it has.
JULIET
Juliet’s HP: Reduced to 90 from 100
(POWER Ability) Power Shot: VFX has been reworked to better highlight Perfect shots
Wedding Gift: Chances to trigger the effect increased from +20/10/5% to +25/12/6%
Guns & Roses: Damage increased from +20/25/30/35% to +28/35/42/49%
Volcanic Shots: AMMO consumed increased from 1 to 3
Lucky Shot: Chances to trigger a POWER from 6/8/10/12% to 4/5/6/7%

Design Notes: Juliet was clearly (and will probably still be!) the most successful character, so we adjusted her base HP to be more in line with other “range” characters. The almighty Volcanic Shots Starting Talent is also adjusted so it encourages more to consider synergy with Talents related to AMMO management rather than just being strong alone or with other ATTACK/POWER talents.

Because of her unique mechanics, where her defense can also function as an attack, Juliet naturally creates synergy across all her abilities. The Lucky Shot Talent further bridges the gap between ATTACK and POWER, and thus DEFENSE. The changes made to Juliet are intended to restore some technical depth to the character compared to the rest of the roster.
[p align="justify"]
Godmother Melody: The Godmother Melody is now available on every Chapter (previously was only on Avalon)
Little Tailor Melody: Now triggers above level 6 (instead of 10) and grants 1 power up (instead of 3)
Goose Girl Melody: Now scales on Damage instead of Levels. Now deals 100 damage every 10 seconds (instead of 150 every 15 seconds)
Morgan’s Quests: Morgan’s Quests in Avalon are now color-coded to set them apart:
King Arthur (Dullahan)’s quest is indicated with a blue door
Mordred’s quest is now indicated with a purple door
Sinbad vs Roc: Sinbad's starting dialogues have been shortened to make the quest flow more smoothly (he was babbling a lot)
Increased Stingy Jack’s HP to 300 from 275
Increased Stingy Jack’s Stagger gauge to 225 from 200

Custom Lobbies: Players can now choose the number of players in a matchmaking game. A slider has been added to select 2, 3, or 4 players. You will only matchmake with players who selected those settings as well
Pings: An option has been added to the Settings menu to display teammates' pings
HUD: We updated the HUD around Heroes to better distinguish between a player's own character and their teammates
Host: It’s now displayed on the Results Screen who was the Host of the game
Status: Protection status (INTANGIBLE and BLOCKING) are now displayed above the Hero to get a better sense of what state we're in
Quick Guide: Added information on the Hourglass of Dreams and the Overtime in the Quick Guide
GENERAL
Modifier: Fixed an issue where ability charges were not properly applied with the ‘Hyperactive’ modifier
HUD: Fixed an issue where the VULNERABLE status timer was not displayed in the HUD
Timer: Fixed an issue where time spent in the Baba Yaga Epilogue didn’t count in the total playtime (sorry for the speedrunners)

Right-joystick: Fixed a behavior where moving the right joystick with any Hero made the circle under the character move (except for the Pied Piper and Kintarō, who use this joystick in their kit, of course!)
Fixed an issue where voice chat was not functional after reconnecting in a session
Fixed an issue that prevented collected Dream Shards from being distributed to a player who reconnected in a session
Fixed an issue where some enemies could not be hit by peers
Crash: Fixed specific crashes that could occur in the Results screen and detailed statistics page
Localization: Fixed multiple localization issues
General: Fixed an issue where some of the Heroes’ projectile abilities (like Merlin’s Fireball, for example) could be stopped by enemies’ abilities (for instance, apples from Avalon’s Witches)
Fixed multiple issues related to the ‘Transfiguration’ Ultimate
Fixed an issue where YANG stance’s damage modifier was not applied to the Vajra Magical Object
Juliet: Fixed a bug that applied POWER’s buff on ATTACKs
Faceless Master Nightmare: Fixed an issue where the rotating beam position was not properly replicated in multiplayer
Hansel & Gretel: Fixed an issue where damage earned with the ‘Ansel & Gretel’ melody was discarded after using a savepoint between Chapters
Green Armor: Fixed an issue where ‘Green Armor’ current count for Armor did not count itself

Romeo & Juliet and Merlin currently have locked Talents for Xbox players. It is due to an error in Xbox’s backend that prevents proper connections to their DLCs. The issue will be fixed in the coming days, as soon as we’re cleared by Microsoft for the release of a patch. We’re sorry for this inconvenience
The Kick timer has been temporarily disabled due to an issue that could break Lobbies
Scarlet’s Signature & Hidden Outfits cannot be unlocked
After using a Raven feather, using Kintaro’s first Ultimate (Giant Carp Supplex) makes Kuma disappear. Teleporting to any location or using the SPECIAL ability will make Kuma appear again
Using Kintaro’s TRAIT ability interrupts the ATTACK and breaks the ATTACK combo

items.text: Greetings, Ravens!
The release date for Kintarō's Hero DLC and our new free update is fast approaching! Now is the time to reveal more details about this new content. Watch out for spoilers!
The Kintarō's Hero DLC will be released on October 12 on all platforms.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625953/96c3a9e44d4a04c49a50fc3f53c27012e8ddcda9.png"]
Kintarō is a famous figure in Japanese folklore, symbolizing bravery and innocence.
In Ravenswatch, Kintarō was raised by Yama-uba, an ogress of the mountain, and lives in harmony with the wild. He speaks to animals, wrestles bears, and carries the mountain’s strength.

The idea behind Kintarō was simple: switch between a classic playstyle and dual gameplay, controlling two characters at once. Kintarō is a child mounted on a bear who wields an axe with exceptional strength!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625953/d78f6d4745bb29d617dd6c55ee38e865a1f81ffa.png"]
Kintarō and Kuma are coming to the Ravenswatch with a full arsenal of Abilities and Ultimates that let them create devastating builds and synergies!
Check out Kintarō in action in his introduction video, which breaks down his entire ability set and play style:
[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KTX85PStGDw"]

Discover Kintarō's story in his fully voiced storyline. The Golden Boy's mother, Yama Uba, sent him on a quest to deliver a message to the witch Baba Yaga. Along the way, Kintarō will discover the lands of Reverie, which have been overrun by destructive creatures, and meet the heroes of the Ravenswatch.

notes.title: Here is an excerpt from Kintarō's Memoirs

items.text: My Yama-uba
wrinkles spread across your face
Ike rivers in spring
My Yama-uba, old ogress of the wild. I speak to you in my thoughts because here no one hears me.

You raised me like the old mountain Ashigara shelters the forest. You watched me from above among the birds and trees, where the wilderness was free and untamed like me! The animals were my brothers and sisters.
You entrusted us with a message enclosed in a flower and sent us away.
So I bear Ashigara’s hope, I remember your face and long for my return.
(Yes, we added a bunch of haikus!)
Unlock exclusive Outfits for Kintarō and his bear, Kuma! Customize your look on the battlefield with 7 skins available in this DLC:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625953/39457fedc5cc38469fc84412da9f856012c79016.png"]

Animating Kintarō and his bear was a real challenge for our animation team! With two very different characters, one a child and the other a four-legged animal, we had to get extra creative to deliver fluid, impressive, and dynamic animations.

In this episode of Raven Eye, our 3D animators Étienne and Benoît take you behind the scenes of Kintarō’s animation. Watch the video closely, you’ll even get a little sneak peek at one of Kintarō’s Ultimates in action!

Playing as Kintarō means knowing when to switch between two types of highly dynamic, all-out combat. There’s nothing more satisfying than climbing on and off the Bear in the middle of a fight to string together devastating attacks!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4809870/Ravenswatch__Kintaro/"]
Whether you prefer to join forces or fight alongside your faithful companion, Kintarō introduces a whole new way to approach combat.
Kintarō's Hero DLC will be available across all platforms for $7,99
Along with the DLC, a free update will also be available to all players! This update will focus primarily on reworking existing Hero talents. But that's not all!
[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=N1qMJbn3CF4"]

In this video, Slymane (Game Designer at Passtech Games), whom you're starting to know, reveals the philosophy behind the Talents Rework players have been eagerly awaiting and gives you a sneak peek at what’s new.

With buffs, behavior changes, and Talents removed and replaced, you’re sure to find a breath of fresh air in this free update! We've revised more than fifty Talents. We'll detail everything in the patch notes upon release, along with design notes from Ravenswatch's designers.

As part of our ongoing effort to improve the Ravenswatch multiplayer experience, we’ve focused this update on creating custom lobbies. Many of you have asked us for this feature, which now lets you choose the number of players you'd like to find in a matchmaking game.
We’ve also added an option to enable a ping indicator between players, so you can check if your connection with your teammates is stable.
As usual, we've made a general balancing pass and added some quality-of-life features to the game. Let's have a look at the most significant ones.
Melodies Balancing
In our latest update, “Songs of Thieves,” we introduced the Melodies mechanic. So it was only natural that we looked at your feedback and made some adjustments.

Among the most common pieces of feedback, some players didn’t like that the Fairy Godmother Melody wasn't available until Chapter 3, or that the Little Tailor Melody didn't trigger until Level 10. Here are the changes we’ve made to these two melodies:

Scarlet Transformation

Scarlet transforming into a wolf, and back again, while the Master Nightmare is stunned? That’s over! We know how frustrating it was to lose those precious seconds of combat. From now on, Scarlet will wait until the boss regains consciousness before shapeshifting!
Clarity of Hero Status Effects

It used to be hard to tell when our character was in “Invincible” or ‘Intangible’ mode, or when they were “Blocking” attacks. Now, a small text appears above your Hero, making their status effects much clearer!

Well, well! We had a lot to say! It won't be long now until the release of the Kintaro DLC and its accompanying free update.
Mark October 12 in your calendar for the release of this new Ravenswatch milestone on all platforms!

releases.displayName: The Songs of Thieves Update (Content Highlights)

items.text: Greetings, everyone!
[p align="justify"]It's time to reveal a little more about Ravenswatch's upcoming free update, “Songs of Thieves”!

[p align="justify"]New enemies, new rooms to explore, brand-new gameplay mechanics... In this post, we’ll explain it all! (Or almost everything...) Spoiler alert: read at your own risk if you want to keep the surprise.
[p align="justify"]Join us on May 7 for Nacon Connect, where we’ll reveal exclusive gameplay footage from the "Songs of Thieves" update, along with its release date.
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]
In this video, environment artists Arthur and Angelica from Passtech Games reveal all the secrets behind the creation of the Thieves’ Stashes!
[p align="justify"]But what are Thieves' Shashes?

[p align="justify"]Across Dark Hills, Storm Island, and Avalon, Thieves have set up camp in Reverie and are hiding their precious loot there. You’ll discover 4 unique types of rooms deep within their hideouts, each with its own challenges or rewards.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625953/2b6d8d484a94d0fc025d6f6d6caa5fa30b9bd927.gif"]

[p align="justify"]Combat rooms are filled with traps, a new mechanic borrowed from our previous game: Curse of the Dead Gods! Watch out for explosive poison barrels, cannonballs, and flaming runes in these secret rooms.
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625953/34319285c828de65e3373db3d7d4e206d3e94b7b.gif"]
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]Free Shards, literally! Fill your pockets in the Thieves' Treasure rooms. So this is what a dream come true looks like?
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625953/eca3512bb71c5961179957e345d2ff9a1b551940.gif"]
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]Cursed rooms will challenge your skill when being amputated from one of your abilities during the whole fight. Hopefully, it won’t curse your favorite one…?
[p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625953/efe92cf24567074461e49596c7af090c6239bdb4.gif"]
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]Make the Magic Mirror happy by asking it to duplicate your Magical Objects! This new feature, which the community has been eagerly awaiting, is sure to delight item collectors…
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]Featuring three different enemies, this new faction will make its debut in the world of Reverie in the upcoming Ravenswatch update! Make way for Bandits, Marksmen, and Assassins.
[p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625953/9e540d8094c65e8591bd5d00fc67efbae57fcb5e.png"]
[p align="justify"] Each with their own specialty (long-range attacks, quick strikes, etc.), the Thieves are highly agile and possess exceptional reflexes.
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625953/699372981f468d0c2352497380397a188e15e7e9.gif"]

[p align="justify"]In addition to being fierce foes, Thieves will also pose a threat to your Dream Shards’ purses. Don’t get hit if you don’t want to end up with empty pockets. Nothing to worry about, right?
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]

With the “Songs of Thieves” update, as you wander through Reverie or explore the Thieves' Stashes, you'll come across mysterious Harps along the way. Activating this magical instrument will release enchanted musical notes.
By composing melodies using musical notes, you'll unlock powerful effects that affect your entire run. With some examples, you'll understand better:
[table equalcells="1" colwidth="100,133,"][td colwidth="100"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625953/015ec42eecc9c04f3e58fa4e284c3c8dae8bcc2d.png"]
[td colwidth="133"]
Long John Silver Melody
Reveals all Raven's landing marks on the map.
[td colwidth="100"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625953/b2ea58eed73fe2da74e3769d60d028ae35679037.png"]
[td colwidth="133"]
Tortoise Melody
Increases the move speed of all Heroes by 20%.
[td colwidth="100"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625953/8e2d15af71f9915404df34841dad08366472756c.png"]
[td colwidth="133"]
Merry Men Melody
Locks no longer need keys to be opened; they now grant 150 Dream Shards each.
It’s up to you to rearrange the 12 available melodies and incorporate them into your strategies!
Thieves aren't the only swindlers showing up in Reverie. Every now and then, you might run into the infamous Stingy Jack and his turnip head.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625953/783ccb2c347b4dd1cf7adcf784b797faa436ce1e.gif"]
This sneaky character will be one step ahead, stripping the chests of their treasures.
It’s up to you to reclaim what’s yours before he escapes! While you’re at it, you can also pad your pockets with his own riches…
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625953/4b71eec04aecb0f79f7d31a10591b1ced510a7ca.png"]
We’ve also included a number of quality-of-life improvements in this update, such as the highly requested Multiplayer Pause feature!

You’ll now be able to pause during co-op matches. Any player can pause the game in Multiplayer, and other party members can resume it after a short time, preventing getting stuck indefinitely in a run. While in pause, players can navigate to the Options, the Map, and their Inventory.
We'll share more information about the Multiplayer Pause and other QoL improvements in the patch notes.
[p align="justify"]

[p align="justify"]A new Mercenaries-themed Skin Pack will be released alongside the "Songs of Thieves" update! Heroes will be featured with special premium Outfits enhanced with 3D model alterations and VFX.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625953/317a065ac96a6aed1cafdf93e9521c8c3efa4558.png"]
[p align="justify"]Snow Queen – The Snow Queen goes rogue in this new wintery Outfit, complemented by ice daggers duly forged to be thrown at the worst Nightmares of Reverie.
[p align="justify"]The Pied Piper – Who called the Plague Doctor? Become the Black Death in this Outfit dripping with green slime. Even your rats are joining you in this new role!
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]Aladdin – What if the best thieves were pirates? Wearing a bandana and wielding scimitars that have been turned into sabers, Aladdin gives off vibes straight from the Caribbean.
[p align="justify"]Sun Wukong – Sun Wukong transforms into a shadowy red ninja by donning a hood and wielding, as always, with flawless precision, this magnificent new staff.
Geppetto – Would you trust this Geppetto, the traveling merchant? In this Outfit, Geppettot traded his trunk for a backpack filled with curiosities and a Hammer-Lantern.
[p align="justify"]The Mercenaries Skin Pack will be available on all platforms for $3,99.
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625953/e92e61496349b2e96366dca73199ac2f05c7cca5.jpg"]

[p align="justify"]Bookmark the next Nacon Connect event for an exclusive look at the Songs of Thieves update! The event will also be filled with new announcements from our publisher Nacon, so don’t miss it!
[p align="justify"]📆 May 7
[p align="justify"]🕚 8 PM CEST
🔗 Watch Live on YouTube
[p align="justify"]We cannot wait.
[p align="justify"]The Passtech Team 🍉

items.text: Greetings, everyone!

[p align="justify"]The Hourglass of Dreams Update is around the corner and will launch on September 18 on all platforms. It’s time to reveal more about what the content is all about in this new major free update!
[p align="justify"]Buckle up! We’re going in for a deep dive, but beware of spoilers if you want to discover it on your own! Take a look a this gameplay montage:
[p align="justify"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625953/bbade04411c14289a5e762f881d17dc81b58aa43.gif"]
[p align="justify"]

The Sandman has decided to make a little room for the Hourglass of Dreams near his shop. This new mechanic activates at the beginning of a new Chapter if you triggered the Master Nightmare before the 18-minute countdown ends in the previous one.

[p align="justify"]For the longest time, players have been asking for some type of reward for triggering the Master Nightmare early. Until now, only a score bonus in the end screen results would highlight this feat, but we always wanted to add something that had a real impact on the runs.
[p align="justify"]Now, you’ll receive a certain amount of rewards depending on when you trigger the Boss (the earlier, the better the rewards and their amounts):
[p align="justify"]Dream Shards
[p align="justify"]Magical Objects
[p align="justify"]XP

[p align="justify"]The Hourglass of Dreams makes up for a new way of playing and new strategies as you progress through your runs. Should you trigger the Boss early and sacrifice points of interest on the map for guaranteed Shards/Items/XP in the next Chapter? Or miss the Hourglass of Dreams rewards because the map has more interesting activities to offer?

[p align="justify"]Fighting a Master Nightmare early has its costs, you'll be weaker than usual in theory. But the well-earned rewards from the Hourglass of Dreams should allow you to start exploring the next Chapter in good shape.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625953/c3477eedd5ea572b4196fee20f64823a7e06cd3f.gif"]
[p align="justify"]
Aah, the timer. If only we had a coin for every time we were asked to remove it or add time to the runs… We could make Ravenswatch 2 (it’s a joke, don’t panic).
[p align="justify"]

The idea of adding time to the timer has always been on our minds, but it couldn't be done without a trade-off. The game is built around this timer, and although a modifier allows you to remove it entirely, this takes away the essence of the game: the tension, the pressure of making choices, and the storytelling.
[p align="justify"]
So here's the new Overtime mechanic! At the end of the initial 18-minute timer, you will automatically enter the “overtime” period, which will allow you to gain up to 3 more minutes.

[p align="justify"]Will you use this extra time to finish your current activity, or to spend your last dream shards at the Sandman? Will you take advantage of it to finish as many activities as possible on the map? Or will you avoid Overtime at all costs?
[p align="justify"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625953/666bba46e2616a9d1985c7cdca713960729adf6e.gif"]
[p align="justify"]

Because while you’re buffing up for the big fight, the Master Nightmare will also take advantage of the Overtime to gain attack power and HP! This gain will be proportional to the time spent in Overtime (up to a certain limit)
[p align="justify"]Once you enter Overtime, you can teleport immediately to the Boss to avoid wasting another second. Spending no to little time in the Overtime will not affect the Master Nightmare.
[p align="justify"]
[p align="justify"]Are you sick of Cynric already? (How could you!). Or you’ve been eaten by the Cyclops one too many times? This update is made for you!

[p align="justify"]The Hourglass of Dreams update brings 3 new optional Quests to Reverie. They will randomly replace the Pigs quests in Dark Hills, Sinbad and the Cyclops in Storm Island, and the Dullahan and Orchad’s tree in Avalon.
[p align="justify"]

In this new quest, you’ll meet with Jack (from Jack and the Beanstalk), who requisitioned you to find his Magic Bean lost in Hogsden. He needs to reach a safe place in the clouds that he once visited, away from the Nightmares threatening his life.
[p align="justify"]Tough break! As he climbs the Magic Bean, he will face the Ogre, who lives in the sky and menaces to make him fall to the ground! It's up to you to stop him!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625953/137c03743f2ebd081f71b639fb926c02e2db7b5e.gif"]
[p align="justify"]

[p align="justify"]Sinbad is back, but this time in a new predicament. You’ll need to escort him through a cave infested by enemies, while he collects diamonds (Sinbad cannot resist a shiny stone). When you finally reach the exit, you’ll face Simorgh, a giant Roc that made the mountain’s peak its nest.
[p align="justify"]You see a threatening enemy to defeat, but Sinbad sees a way to escape the island with his loot. Knock down and tame Simorgh to help Sinbad flee.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625953/cc9d1e1f4056f7cc0fef7a954f3def105ab188a9.gif"]
[p align="justify"]
Morgan is not done in her quest to save Avalon and restore its former glory. This time, her illegitimate son Mordred has taken possession of King Arthur’s crown and threatens to destroy it.
[p align="justify"]
Morgan can only hold on for so long, so you’ll have to navigate the tombs of the fallen city to reach and get rid of Mordred.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625953/683e0168e0b42f0059f02abe2faabf0a6aa095b1.gif"]A new activity makes its way into Reverie. Rid the Leprechaun’s Cauldron of the Nightmares spawning around it. But be quick! The cauldron will start to empty itself of its Dream Shards as soon as you activate it.
[p align="justify"]
It’s time for Scarlet, her Wolf form, Aladdin, Melusine, and Geppetto to get their special premium Outfits enhanced with 3D model alterations and VFX!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42625953/44a11ad2e709a2f372b9d230bf515e2152170dc8.png"]

[p align="justify"]Geppetto – A pyrotechnician costume for Geppetto, with a new gleaming hot hammer and a backpack filled with fireworks and turning gears. In addition to his cap and full beard, he put on his best jacket.

[p align="justify"]Scarlet and her Wolf form – Their skull-shaped masks are reminiscent of obscure forest cults. Scarlet’s human form wields a dagger made of bone. Filling their combo points triggers a magical red smoke coming out of their shoulder pads.
[p align="justify"]Aladdin – Aladdin removes his hood to reveal a stylish new look! The sand guardian will shine brightly as his Enchantment bar fills up.
[p align="justify"]Melusine – With her serpent tail, Melusine reveals a new form of mermaid queen, always ready for battle. A trail of water follows her like a cape. Splash!
[p align="justify"]Get the Timeless Skin Pack on September 18 – available on all platforms for $3,99.
[p align="justify"]
Steam achievements, Romeo & Juliet balancing, more decor variety in the enemy camps… The new update is filled with even more content to discover on September 18.

items.text: Greetings, Ravens
We've got important news to share today regarding the launch of the Nightmares Unleashed update on all platforms. Please read this message from the Passtech and Nacon teams:
We apologize for this delay, and we'll get back to you as soon as possible with a new release date for the Nightmares Unleashed update.
The Passtech and Nacon teams
Greetings, everyone!
Buckle up! Today, we’re telling you EVERYTHING you need to know about the Nightmares Unleashed Update—or at least most of it.

This first Major Free Content update will be released in early 2025, focusing primarily on replayability. Check out the Content Highlights below for a sneak peek of what’s coming, but beware of spoilers!

Ever since Early Access, the Keys system in Ravenswatch has been a hot topic in the community. Hard to locate, not shared among the group… In this update, we tried to address most of the feedback reported by the players (and more!) by changing a few fundamental things.
Slymane, Game designer at Passtech Games, reveals the thoughts and processes behind those changes in our latest video. It’s also giving a peek in action at some of the new upcoming content!
As part of this redesign, Keys are now revealed on the mini-map by Vision Towers and by walking close by.

Master Nightmares are coming back stronger than ever in the Nightmares Unleashed Update. New boss patterns have been added to all three Master Nightmares. The goal was to create a surprise effect: each time you meet them, you will get a different combination of attacks.
More are to be discovered, and you must stay on your guard so you don’t get caught in the unleashing of the Master Nightmares!
Two new Mini-bosses join Reverie, to your great misfortune.
In Storm Island, you’ll get to confront Abu Al Jaan, the ancestor of all the Jinns. Careful on whom he may possess...

And in the sewers of Avalon, you’ll have to face Melion, the servant knight of King Arthur transformed into a Werewolf by his mischievous wife. Melion will be accompanied by his loyal pack, so be careful not to get bitten!

Our focus for this new Major Update was to expand your experience in all three Chapters available in Ravenswatch. We want each run to feel new and different, especially when travelling through Reverie.
We’ve made changes to existing activities, such as the Tumors, but we mostly added new events. Check them out:

If you’ve watched our video at the beginning of this news, you already know what this new activity is about! Blood rituals have taken place in Reverie, and a new enemy guards their precious reward. Break the ritual by defeating the Summoner Cultists, and get your hands on two Keys for your next adventures.
Locked chests make their apparitions on the map, and will require a Key to open them. Inside? An item times two! What a way to facilitate your future Magical Object collections!
The Sacrificial Idol is exactly what it looks like. Sacrifice a part of your health points to gain more flat Damage (DMG). Sounds a bit like Curse of the Dead Gods, uh?
You’ve asked for more Stars of Fate? We deliver! This new mechanism will let you choose between 3 options:
Vision of Fate (gain Stars of Fate / Rerolls)
Vision of Renewal (relearn all of your Talents except starting one with chances of higher quality)
Vision of Enlightment (upgrade two different randomly chosen Talents)

Your path will no longer be shared only by humanoid pigs and strange creatures. Meet the Refugees, a small group of people asking for your help in the land of Reverie. Those misfortuned souls will prove to be a glimmer of hope in your journey, or a bad decision around the corner. Choose wisely when speaking to them!
With these new NPCs, we wanted to highlight the few last humans remaining in Reverie, and how they're trying to survive. They may become a great help if you choose to help them.
More things are coming with the Nightmares Unleashed Update! As usual, we’ll reveal it all in our future Devstreams and detailed patch notes, so stay tuned!
The Nightmares Unleashed Update is planned to launch in early 2025. We’re still polishing up some content and getting everything ready for a good and stable release.

For now, we’re off to a short winter break! The Passtech team wishes you a happy Holiday season with your loved ones. See you soon in 2025 for the beginning of a new Ravenswatch adventure with us! We cannot wait.

You’ve been heard, Ravens!

After reading your feedback on our latest patch, it became clear that some of our changes were not welcomed by the community. We hear you and this patch will address the main issue reported by players: the economy.
While our intentions were never to put a strain on players, we recognize that this drastic change was not in line with the community’s expectations (and ultimately our own).

By adjusting the economy, we were hoping to pivot the narrative of accumulating too many Magical Objects during a game, as we mentioned in a previous Dev Diary. We now understand that this solution was not adapted and fair to players.

It's safe to say that our impression was wrong! If players want an even more challenging experience with the Nightmare Difficulty, our main focus should be around the Custom Game Mode modifiers and changes on specific combos from now on, as pointed out by some members of the community here.

Let’s dive into the patch note!
🐦 = Community additions, suggestions, reports
Because we know our patch notes are lengthy ones and you probably just want to play, here’s a “too long, didn’t read!” summary just for you:
Voice chat is here!
Many improvements in VFX, decors, and UI
Faster Teleportation animations
Chapter 3 balancing
Heroes balancing
Crit Chance balancing
Economy balancing in higher difficulties
Quests balancing
Lots of fixes

⚠ Note: In the preparation of version 1.0, some interfaces have been modified to welcome the changes of the full release. Things like Skins/Outfits are displayed but not available in this version of the game (they cannot be unlocked as well, navigation is greyed out). Some interfaces can feel wonky because of it. Take it as a little teasing of what’s coming!
🐦 Voice chat: Vocal chat is finally here!
Voice chat is disabled by default, you can activate it in the Options menu
Settings can be updated in the Audio tab: Open Microphone, Push-to-Talk, Muted, and Disabled
Push-to-talk is bindable in the keyboard section. Not available for Pads yet

Note: Beware, this is a very early version of the Voice chat and social features that we have in mind. A lot of quality-of-life options are missing and will be added for version 1.0. We’re launching it today to start collecting feedback and bug reports so that we’re ready for the full release!
Health bars: Visualisation for Enemies health bars has been improved
Bar length is smaller or larger, depending on the enemy's pool health (Small, Regular, or Elite)
Mini-Bosses now display a Boss health bar at the top of the screen
The Boss health bar now displays their status effects

🐦 Teleportation : Cinematic reduced from 6 to 4 seconds.: Note: Teleporting could feel a bit sluggish at times, so we tweaked the timing to avoid players feeling stuck for too long during the landing animations.
Compendium: Some changes in the layout of the Heroes’ Compendium

items.text: Greetings, Ravens!

Wow, it’s been a hectic month! We’re glad today to take some time to retrospect on the Fall of Avalon update that came out last month, as well as to chat about our short/medium-term plans for Ravenswatch.
But first and foremost, how are you doing? :)
We’ve got quite a bit of things to tackle in this dev diary, here’s a summary of the subjects you can read about in detail below:
Crazy positive response to the Fall of Avalon update, thank you!
Reacting to feedback and data from the community
What do YOU think of the Custom Game Modes?
Balancing patch incoming?
What about version 1.0?

notes.title: The Madness of the Fall of Avalon Update

items.text: I think “Madness” pretty much sums up everything about the Fall of Avalon update. The content, the reception, the numbers, the balancing (😈)... We thought BIG with the update and BIG we received!
The Fall of Avalon update is the largest iteration ever made to Ravenswatch’s Early Access and we didn’t even plan it this way.

We were approached by our friends at Evil Empire for the Triple-i Initiative, and seized the opportunity to make a big boom! After all, the Fall of Avalon update was already shaping up to be the bulkiest of our Early Access, so it was the perfect opportunity to introduce Ravenswatch to new people. We knew that many players were also waiting for more content before finally taking the plunge into Reverie's nightmares, and we were delighted to see players' positive opinions on the update.
We enjoyed the event very much (soooo many cool games were revealed) and we hope you did too. You can see the full replay here:

With 5,940 concurrent active players the week of the launch, the Fall of Avalon update is simply our greatest release since the beginning of the Early Access! We know that it can look pale compared to some recent successes on Steam, but that’s still a very impressive number for our small team, and for a game that has been in EA for more than a year. And the icing on the cake was going from Mostly Positive to Very Positive on the overall score of the game on Steam! The team is very proud and grateful, thank you all!

notes.title: Looking at the data & balancing matters

items.text: Here’s a cool infographic of in-game stats, dating back to this month:
There's one subject that doesn't stand out in this infographic, and that's Custom Game Modes! Here's a short video explaining this new feature, which we shared at the AG French Direct this week:

With the additions of Custom Modes and Challenges, we aimed to give a breath of fresh air to players who wanted to rediscover the game from a different angle. They make Ravenswatch more accessible for new/chill players, let you test out some funky combinations, and can also provide an extra challenge for hardcore players.

What do you think of Custom modes? Our in-game stats show that 13% of games (of all difficulty levels) use at least 1 Game Modifier, and we think that's already a pretty cool number! We'd love to hear more opinions on the matter so that we can improve the system and add new modifiers. If you've got a bit of time to spare, here's a questionnaire you can fill out.

notes.title: Did we talk about Madness already?

items.text: On the topic of balancing, we’ve spent a considerable amount of time reading your feedback, watching videos and live streams, and checking our data. We spotted quite a few interesting things!
We're happy with the balancing for the "Adventure" difficulty mode. The game is globally more fun to play because it’s more permissive.

We did note, however, that Avalon's enemies were oversized in terms of damage, and were very hard on players arriving at Chapter 3. A rebalancing of their damage according to the difficulty modes is planned. On the same note, and for a healthier feeling of progression within a run, the Master Nightmares in Chapters 2 (Faceless) and 3 (Claws) are also oversized in terms of resistance. This is harder to notice, as there are currently too many ways to "break" the game. But for players who don't make builds optimally, these bosses are too powerful.

Our main takeaway from watching your videos and studying your feedback is that access to Magical Objects is too important in the game: players are picking up more objects than we estimated (especially in the higher difficulties, or for hardcore players who know the game's meta inside out). The result is a feeling of power that greatly exceeds the game's level. It's also combined with the fact that players have too many ways of controlling the game's RNG (with the abundance of rerolls) and that build synergies (talents, power-ups, items…) that should be exceptional to do aren't all that exceptional. This detail detracts greatly from the game's replayability, as it becomes too easy to reproduce epic situations and feel overpowered. We feel that we’ve lost a little of the challenge in the game's higher difficulties.

A more minor issue is the fact that there are major imbalances in the crit chances and crit damage builds. This results in certain build configurations literally flying in terms of damage figures that unbalance the game dramatically 😄

There you go! We got a bit candid here in our analysis of the feedback received from the Fall of Avalon update. We hope you enjoy this kind of design-nerd talk as much as we do, and that it helps the community understand the changes we make in the balancing of the game. Currently, we’re testing out a few solutions to improve the feeling of being “overpowered” without sacrificing the fun and satisfaction of going crazy with the builds. As mentioned before, we quite like the current challenge of the Adventure mode so we’re looking more into having an economy that complexifies the other difficulty modes. We’ll share more on this matter when we’ll be confident about our changes!
Now what? It’s already been a month since the release of the Fall of Avalon update.

Most of the team has been focusing on version 1.0 and the console versions, and this has become our priority. We want to focus all our efforts on finishing this Early Access development by providing the community with a polished final experience.

We've got lots of ideas to implement and lots of player suggestions to incorporate, so it's going to take some time. Don't worry if we become a little quieter and less regular in releasing content/patches, we’ll share our progress along the way. We are considering releasing a balancing patch in the coming weeks, but that would slow down our 1.0. progress, so we're still debating the idea! Stay tuned for that!
Here’s a reminder of our plans for the full release of Ravenswatch:
Final confrontation against a special someone…
A new Hero joins the Ravenswatch!
Achievements
Skins
Vocal chat
Consoles: PS4, PS5, Xbox One, Xbox Series, Nintendo Switch
And more we’re hushing for now…
That is it for today’s Dev diary, we hope you enjoyed this long read. You can always ask your questions or share your feedback on the Steam forums or our official Discord. Talk to you soon!

items.text: Greetings, Ravens!
New Dev Diary incoming! After being quiet for a few months, this one is going to be a good and long read! We were very busy with this update, which turned out to be a MASSIVE one.
Last week, we revealed that the Fall of Avalon would be released on April 22nd, that's in a week! Today we’re diving into all (or almost) the details of what's coming in this update.
Brave enough to continue? Let’s go!
The third Chapter of Ravenswatch is finally here! Or at least, it’s coming out very soon! 😇 On April 22nd, explore a new map with new enemies, new challenges, and a new Master Nightmare to defeat!

Avalon is the last stop on the heroes' journey to overcome the Nightmares (or is it?). Meet dangerous Witches, dishonored Knights, and corrupted Wolves in the fallen city of Avalon. We’re also keeping the last enemy type a secret so there are still some surprises on the release day, but do you want to take guesses? 😏
The Coven is waiting for you
WOLVES!!!

Along your journey, you may find a mysterious woman named Morgan, asking for your help in the abandoned city of Avalon. Her brother, the King, is threatening the last hope of light on the corrupted lands of Reverie. Defeat the Headless Horseman (Dullahan) in this new themed quest available in the third Chapter of Ravenswatch.
Help Morgan to defeat her brother
Slay the Dullahan

Finally, are you up to the challenge of a new Master Nightmare? We couldn’t resist a little tease in our Reveal Date trailer, but sorry that’s all you’ll get today! Maybe tune in tomorrow during our Devstream for a first official look at this new boss.

Ravenswatch's Early Access is not done yet, even with the Fall of Avalon update! We're getting closer to the end but we have still a lot of work ahead of us for version 1.0. If you’ve missed it, watch our latest trailer showcased at the Triple-i Initiative event last week for a good look at the Fall of Avalon update:

Custom runs and Challenges are making their big debuts in the Fall of Avalon update! In addition to a whole new Chapter to explore, we thought: why not even more replayability with a way to customize runs?

With modifiers, players will be able to tailor their Ravenswatch experience the way they want it to be. No more timer? Done. Play only during Nighttime? Done. All enemies are Corrupted? Done. No Mini-Map? Done. We could go on… But we’ll let you discover all that on April 22nd! You’ll be able to lower or increase the challenge with the Custom Modes.
With those modifiers, we created pre-made Challenges that you can select both in solo or in co-op. Here’s an example of a Challenge we curated for you 😈 :
Explorer: No countdown before Master Nightmare awakening
One Chapter: Play a single random Chapter
Angry Birds: Heroes start with no raven feather, and none can be recovered
Shadowy Fog: The map is not displayed and cannot be used
Lack of Imagination: 1 offers less for each choice of Talent or reward
Want to see this live? Join us tomorrow on Twitch for an exclusive showcase of the custom modes and challenges!

items.text: Greetings, Ravens!

As our latest Dev Diary stated, we’ve been working hard to bring players a more stable co-op experience worldwide. Starting February 1st, we will use Epic Online Services to manage connections between players.

We've already tackled many of the network issues since the beginning of the Early access, but some online problems remain and are harder to track down and eliminate (starting to sound less like debugging and more like hitman-related stuff...). We want to make our thinking and process clear, so here's a little transparency on what we're working on and what we have identified:

When players are having trouble establishing a connection in P2P together (because of firewalls, VPNs, location, etc.), our server creates a relay between them. We believe that it's this relay that creates packet losses and leads to extensive delays, intangible enemies, disconnections, and more.

We've located the issue with the relay, so our short-term move is to try several possible solutions to prevent more problems from happening. We're hoping this will help to create a more stable experience for co-op runs, especially with delays and intangible enemies. This patch is a first step towards those solutions. But this is not a miracle solution, so we do not believe we should stop there, as it won't help with the high PINGs people are reporting. We're also working on a more long-term solution, detailed below.

We will change our current service provider, so we can better distribute this relay across the world and benefit from a more stable solution. We've made some good progress with Epic Online Services (EOS) in the last few weeks and we are currently testing the integration of this new tech. We expect it to be a big structural change, so we want to make the transition as smooth as possible. This will help with all the general issues related to delays, disconnections, and high PINGs.

releases.displayName: What's coming in the Sun Wukong Update - Dev Diary #05

items.text: Greetings, Ravens!
We're here with another Dev diary about the upcoming changes and updates of Ravenswatch!

I’ll try to be concise and make this post short, so let’s jump into the news right away! If you’ve watched our recent Reveal trailer, you’ll know Ravenswatch’s new update will feature a new playable character: Sun Wukong. He’s directly inspired by the most famous Chinese classical literature hero, the Monkey King himself will join the Ravenswatch on November 16th.
Ahead of the release, we wanted to share a quick overview of the character, so you’ll know what to expect from this new Hero.

Our version of Sun Wukong is deprived of his godly powers. His crown has been possessed by an unremovable force, sapping his powers and putting an end to his divinity. He is now raging and bitter about his new mortality. The loss of his powers has also made him return to his primal instincts and his ape-like attitude. That doesn’t make him any less mighty as you can get an overpowered feeling by playing Sun Wukong, thanks to his fancy and flashy moves and his incredible mastery of martial arts.

We created Sun Wukong with the idea of Duality in mind. The first thing you’ll notice with him is the Yin and Yang stances, that you can switch during combat. The Yang stance makes you deal +100% damage, but also take +100% damage. High risk and reward, but you’ll also benefit from Strength for a short time. The Yin stance on the other hand makes you get Life on Hit for all of your abilities, as well as applying a Shield for a few seconds. Perfect for recovering the health you just lost by taking too many risks with the Yang stance!

You now understand, Sun Wukong requires more skill than any other character. And if you come from Curse of the Dead Gods, our previous game, you may be very happy to see the Parry make its comeback (sort of, it’s not exactly as punitive as Curse of the Dead Gods. We’re not monsters). You’ll need to balance the two stances, take risks, block attacks, and grow stronger to bring Sun Wukong to his full potential.

We could talk quickly about Sun Wukong’s Ultimate abilities, but frankly, we’d rather let you discover them by yourselves! Sun Wukong will also come with 17 Talents to upgrade your main abilities, we cannot wait to see how creative your builds and strategies will be.

The Online Matchmaking system or quick match, whatever you want to call it, has been the Number #1 requested feature since the launch of Ravenswatch in Early Access. We had planned this feature for later in the development of the game, but after seeing the demand we decided to bring it sooner and move some other stuff for later.

In the Sun Wukong update, you’ll now be able to look for Players online and create custom lobbies. That’s why the page on the right side has been modified a little bit to welcome the changes with the Matchmaking system.

We still consider it an early version of the system we have in mind, and it’s missing some key features like Vocal chat or more co-op information in the HUD, like the health of your teammates and such. We’ll improve the User Interface as well as make the connection more stable between the players in patches along the Early Access of Ravenswatch.

Even though there are no current Vocal features, it was impossible to release this matchmaking system without adding the simplest form of communication between the players: Pings on the map. Another highly requested feature that we decided to add in this update. Open the map and select a spot to ping it to alert players of your strategy or desired directions.

We hope you’ll enjoy it! Just know there’s room for improvement and we’ll listen to your feedback and suggestions on the matchmaking system. It was just too important and requested to wait more before adding it.

Onto another big thing: the Difficulty modes! The release of the second Chapter, Storm Island, made us realize the need for an overhaul of the Difficulty system. It also fits with the new matchmaking system, as it is way easier to choose between 4 difficulty modes than 10 to find players across the world.

So what does this revamp mean? We’ve condensed the 10 difficulties (from Normal to Nightmare 9) into 4 tailored challenges, with a real feeling of an escalating difficulty. Basically, we did not really like how tedious it could get to reach the highest difficulty levels of the game, especially with now two Chapters and a third in the works. It is still up to balancing of course, and we’ll probably rework it again for version 1.0 with more game-changing modifiers. But for now, it will do fine!
Passtech Games Discord

📝 One note about those changes: we will need to reset your progression on Difficulties as it’s necessary for this overhaul. We hope it’s not too much of an inconvenience but the game being in Early Access makes it inevitable in some cases to not reset progress for some features. We want to reassure you that the rest of the progression is not affected, so Heroes’ Ranks, unlocked Talents & Magical Objects are fine and not reset!

Quick but worthy of a mention: in case you’ve missed the patch 0.14.03, we’ve fixed the Steam deck issues with telegraphed attacks and some crashes. If you’re a Deck player the Sun Wukong update will be the perfect time to jump back into the game! Let us know what you think, but it surely runs smoothly now!

Will you add a Reroll mechanic for Talents or Magical Objects?: The Reroll suggestion is a frequently requested feature from the community, and we're totally into that! We'll have to think about how to implement it in the current game loop, but it's something that you can expect to see arrive during the Early Access.

Are you considering giving players some way to restore Ravens' Feathers?: Yes! We're currently working on the design of this new mechanic. It will require new content for both Chapters, as well as ideas for visual representations of the shrine/altar, but you can expect this in the near future.

Are Skins or cosmetics coming to the game?: Why are people so interested in Skins and cosmetics?! (no, actually we understand). The short answer is: Yes, but for version 1.0.: The longer answer is: We rather focus on core content and put priority on improving the already existing experience of the game. But with that said, we have already started designing some alternative skins for Heroes and all I can say is that they totally rock!
Join our Devstreams next week to learn more about the new Hero, Matchmaking, reworked Difficulties, and more!
